name: zzsearchstub
title: Zzsearchstub
description: Throwaway standalone acceptance connector covering the mixed filter shape: one search tool whose filter declares its fields and one that omits them and therefore emits a throwing stub. The mix is the point — src/search-filter.ts must then name fieldsFromKeys, makeQueryFilter and SearchFilter, and neither more nor less, which is what the generated package's own typecheck and lint decide.

tools.name: zzsearchstub_item_search
tools.description: Substring search across items. Matches id and name.

tools.name: zzsearchstub_event_search
tools.description: Substring search across events. The searchable fields are not expressible as top-level keys, so the emitted filter is a stub to be replaced by hand.
